how.title: How it works
how.1_body: Add a photo or PDF. We don't save your bill.
how.2_body: Household size and yearly income. That is what hospitals use to decide.
how.3_body: See what the hospital's own policy says, with the exact line it comes from.
upload.title: Add your bill
upload.sub: A photo or PDF works. We don't save your bill.
upload.formats: JPG, PNG, HEIC or PDF, up to 15 MB
upload.bad_file: That file type won't work. Try a photo or PDF under 15 MB.
upload.sample_failed: The sample bill didn't load. Choose a file, or type it in instead.
reading.title: Reading your bill
reading.status: Looking for the details that matter…
reading.sample_banner: Sample reading: the bill reader isn't connected yet.
hospital.label: Which hospital is this?
hospital.matched_hint: We matched this from your bill. Change it if it's wrong.
hospital.pick_hint: We only know a few hospitals so far. Pick yours from the list.
manual.title: Type in your bill
manual.sub: Copy these from your bill. Skip anything you can't find.
questions.title: Two quick questions
questions.sub: Hospitals decide using household size and yearly income.
questions.income_error: Enter your yearly income, or 0 if none.
result.checking: Comparing your answers with the hospital's policy…
result.title.cannot_determine: We couldn't tell from this policy
result.fpl_one: Your income is about {pct}% of the federal poverty line for 1 person.
result.fpl_other: Your income is about {pct}% of the federal poverty line for {n} people.
result.no_quote: The policy doesn't say this in one clear line.
result.double_check: Double-check this line with the hospital.
result.next.payment_plan: Ask the billing office about a payment plan.
result.next.check_errors: Ask for an itemized bill and check it for errors.
result.next.dollarfor: Dollar For can look at your case for free.
result.next.call: Call the billing office and ask for a financial assistance application.
result.fine: Likely eligible — not a guarantee. The hospital makes the final decision.
result.sample_banner: Sample result: the eligibility service isn't connected yet.
result.sample_note: This is an example of a result. It isn't based on your answers.
result.unavailable: We can't check eligibility right now. Try again in a minute.
result.app_failed: We couldn't make the application right now. Try again in a minute.
reading.check_first: Check the highlighted detail first: fix it, or tap “It's right”.
note.account_format: This doesn't look like a usual account number. Check it against your bill.
hospital.no_match: We couldn't match your hospital. Pick it below.
how.trust: BillBack reads the hospital's own policy and shows you the exact line. A rule, not an AI guess, makes the call. We don't save your bill.
footer.data: Data: 2026 HHS poverty guidelines and each hospital's published financial assistance policy
result.help: Questions? Call the hospital's billing office
result.next_2: Attach the documents on the checklist.
result.next_3: Send it to the address on your bill. Follow up in 30 days.
caveat.residency: You may need to live in this hospital's service area.
caveat.assets: Your savings or property may count.
caveat.not_stated: The policy doesn't say anything about {what}.
plain.application_window: how long you have to apply
plain.missing_assets: how much you have in savings or property
plain.unclear_home_area: the policy's home-area rule (unclear in the policy)
plain.unclear_savings: the policy's savings rule (unclear in the policy)
meta.title: BillBack: you may not owe this bill
wow.receipt.show: See it in the hospital's policy
wow.receipt.alt: Page {page} of {hospital}'s financial assistance policy. Highlighted: “{quote}”
wow.receipt.found: The boxed line is on page {page} of the hospital's own policy.
wow.receipt.not_found: We couldn't box this line on the page. It's on page {page}.
wow.slider.title: What if my income were different?
wow.slider.sub: Drag to see where this hospital's lines are. The answer comes from the same rules as your result.
wow.slider.per_year: a year, about {pct}% of the poverty line
wow.slider.note: This is only a what-if. It doesn't change your result or your application.
wow.read.title: Read it to me
wow.read.script_title: What to say when you call the billing office
wow.read.call_1_no_account: Hi, I'm calling about my bill.
wow.read.call_2: I'd like to apply for financial assistance under your hospital's financial assistance policy.
wow.read.call_3: Can you send me the application, or tell me where to send it?
wow.read.call_4: Can you please put a hold on collections while my application is reviewed?
wow.deadline.title: Your deadline
wow.deadline.passed: Date passed: call the billing office
wow.deadline.from_service: Apply by {date} ({days} days after your {visit} visit).
wow.deadline.at_least: You have at least until {date}: {days} days, counted from your first bill after you left the hospital. You likely have a little longer.
wow.deadline.no_date: The policy gives {days} days to apply. We don't know your visit date, so apply as soon as you can.
wow.deadline.none: The policy doesn't give a deadline. Apply as soon as you can.
wow.benefits.question: Does anyone in your household get SNAP (food stamps), Medicaid or WIC?
wow.benefits.title: Benefits
wow.benefits.auto_tell: Tell the billing office you get the benefit, and include the benefit letter.
wow.benefits.no_auto: This policy doesn't mention automatic approval for SNAP, Medicaid or WIC, but include your benefit letter. It's strong proof of income.
wow.law.title: State law
wow.law.note: This may give you more than the hospital's policy. It's information, not legal advice. BillBack's result above uses the hospital's own policy.
map.title: Same bill, very different rules
map.lead: We've read {n} hospitals' policies so far. Their free-care limits range from {min}% to {max}% of the poverty line.
map.dot_label: {name}, {state}: free care up to {free} of the poverty line
map.tip_free: Free care: up to {pct} of the poverty line
map.table_caption: Hospitals whose policies we've read, with their income limits as a percent of the poverty line
wow.appeal.link: If they say no: get an appeal letter
wow.own_form.note: Your application also includes {hospital}'s own form. We filled in only the date; you fill in the rest and sign it.
err.bad_file: That file won't work. Try a photo or PDF.
err.too_large: That file is too big. Try a smaller photo or PDF.
err.invalid_input: Some answers are missing or out of range. Check them and try again.
err.not_found: We couldn't find that anymore. If we read a policy for you earlier, it has expired: read it again.
err.live_off: Reading a policy from a link is turned off right now. Upload the PDF instead.
err.demo_only: In this demo we can only read the sample files.
err.bad_url: That link doesn't look right. Paste a link that starts with https://.
err.fetch_timeout: That link took too long to open.
err.not_pdf: That link isn't a policy we can read.
err.no_pdf_link: We couldn't find the policy PDF on that page.
err.pdf_encrypted: That PDF is locked, so we can't read it.
err.pdf_empty: That PDF has no text we can read.
err.too_short: That document is too short to be a full policy.
err.not_policy: That doesn't look like a financial assistance policy.
err.ai_unavailable: Our reader is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
err.ai_invalid: We couldn't make sense of that document.
err.server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a minute.
err.network: We can't reach BillBack right now. Check your connection and try again.
problem.quote_not_found: We couldn't find this sentence word for word in the policy.
problem.policy_unclear: The policy isn't clear about this.
problem.low_confidence: Our reader wasn't sure about this.
problem.failed_sanity_check: This number looks unusual for a policy like this.
live.value.free_up_to: Free if your household income is up to {pct}% of the poverty line.
live.value.discount_up_to: Some discount if your household income is up to {pct}% of the poverty line.
live.value.assets_count: Your savings or property may count.
live.value.residency_area: You may need to live in: {area}.
live.value.residency_required: You may need to live in the hospital's area.
live.value.residency_none: No rule about where you live.
live.value.window_from_service: {days} days to apply, counted from your visit.
live.value.window_from_discharge: {days} days to apply, counted from when you left the hospital.
live.value.window_from_first_bill: {days} days to apply, counted from your first bill after you left.
live.value.window_no_number: The policy gives no number of days. Read its words below.
live.reading_status: This can take up to a minute. We read it now and don't save it.
live.read_now_body: We read this policy for this visit only. It's gone when you leave. This is new: compare it with the policy.
live.manual_note: We'll use the limits you typed. Nothing is saved.
live.curated_note: We already know this hospital's policy, so we used the version we checked.
live.check_body: Compare these with the policy before you rely on them.
live.no_quote: No sentence from the policy for this.
live.state_label: Which state is the hospital in?
live.state_error: Enter the state as 2 letters, like WI.
reading.unreadable_title: We couldn't read this photo clearly
reading.unreadable_body: The photo looks {reasons}. Take a new photo in good light with the phone steady, or type the details yourself. We'll fill in what we could read.
reading.unreadable_body_plain: Take a new photo in good light with the phone steady, or type the details yourself. We'll fill in what we could read.
reading.blurry_title_plain: This photo is hard to read
reading.blurry_body: Check each detail carefully against your bill.
manual.prefilled_title: We filled in what we could read
manual.prefilled_body: Check every detail against your bill. We weren't sure about the highlighted ones.
hospital.search_placeholder: Type the hospital's name or state
hospital.results_one: 1 hospital found. Use the up and down arrows to choose.
hospital.results_many: {n} hospitals found. Use the up and down arrows to choose.
hospital.no_results: No hospital matches. Choose “My hospital isn't listed”.
hospital.not_listed_hint: Next, we'll help you find and read your hospital's policy.
notlisted.title: Let's find your hospital's policy
notlisted.banner_title_plain: We haven't read this hospital's policy yet
notlisted.banner_body: Every nonprofit hospital has to publish a financial assistance policy. Give it to us and we'll read it now. We don't save it.
notlisted.upload_only: Download the policy PDF from the hospital's website, then upload it here.
notlisted.url_blank: Paste the link to the policy first.
notlisted.url_bad: That doesn't look like a web link. It should start with https://.
notlisted.pdf_too_large: That PDF is over 25 MB. Try a smaller copy.
notlisted.find_search: Search the web for “{hospital} financial assistance policy”.
notlisted.find_billing: Look on the hospital's website, on the billing or “patient financial services” page.
notlisted.find_call: Call the billing office and ask for the “financial assistance policy” and the “plain language summary”.
notlisted.dollarfor_body: Dollar For is a nonprofit that helps patients apply for charity care, for free.
notlisted.manual_sub: If you have the policy but we can't read it, copy two numbers from it. Look for “% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines” (or FPL).
notlisted.manual_free: Free care up to (% of the poverty line)
notlisted.manual_discount: Discounts up to (% of the poverty line, optional)
notlisted.manual_discount_hint: For example 400. Leave blank if the policy doesn't say.
notlisted.err_limit_blank: Enter the free-care limit from the policy.
notlisted.err_below_free: The discount limit can't be lower than the free-care limit.
questions.household_blank: Enter how many people live in your household.
questions.household_zero: Count yourself: a household has at least 1 person.
questions.household_too_many: Enter 20 people or fewer. For a bigger household, call the billing office.
questions.income_negative: Income can't be less than 0. Enter 0 if you have no income.
questions.income_too_high: That's more than we can check. Enter your yearly income in dollars.
result.app_ready: It's downloading now. Look in your Downloads folder, then sign it and send it to the hospital.
result.live_note: We read this policy just now. It isn't saved, so it's gone when you leave.
